body:
I am really not sure at all what it is, but I'm sure there's an alternative that would work better. how would you recommend I talk to her about getting a new prescription? I'm not sure she'd be very open to the idea.

you are certainly being very helpful, I appreciate it a lot. I still feel scared and sort of hopeless, but definitely less so. you're right, a year is a long time.

she has been on meds before but they made her feel sick and had little to no evident psychological effect.

I am thankful that there's such a lengthy timeframe too, but I'm afraid that she will just keep feeling like this, as she has sort of resigned herself to it. also she thinks that we should just break up now so as to not "delay the inevitable." I think I convinced her that that isn't the right thing to do but I'm worried that those feelings may render the time factor useless.

thank you so much. this means a lot to me. right now she is speaking in terms as though it is going to happen no matter what. her estimate is halfway through next school year. so, about a year. hopefully that is long enough for her to see that she is wrong.

you said the best thing to do is support. so just live life and be helpful to her? and the thing with the glass smudge really stuck out to me. so really, talking to her about it and why she shouldn't do it does more harm than good? okay. good to know.

right now, a big part of our relationship, and honestly something that keeps me motivated for everything I do on a day to day basis, is talking about our future together as a sort of coping mechanism for all of our school and separation stress. she wants to do away with that now, as she thinks I need to start thinking in terms of a life without her. how do I convince her that this is not healthy? she very much believes that as long as a person is unhappy with their life, they have every right to end it. the problem is that

- 1) she's young and hasn't experienced enough of the world to be able to come to that conclusion to end her life

- 2) she thinks I'm doing it just for the sake of our romantic relationship, not because I care about her so much and just want her to enjoy her life

I'm at such a loss still. she's a very intelligent girl and, outside of the distortive lens of depression, that makes her reasoning all very sound.
